text:
Maria Serrano: Quick heads-up — we're doing the base image rebuild tonight (staging -> canary). Need a short RBAC change so the image-signer job can use the KMS signer key and write attestations. Also want to bump audit-log retention for signing events to 90d for the rollout window. Who can approve and apply in staging?

Ben Liu: I can approve the RBAC delta but need the minimal IAM/KMS policy to ship to infra. Can we keep it narrow?

Maria Serrano: @Ben here's what I was thinking (minimal):

```json
{
  "bindings": [
    {
      "role": "roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeySigner",
      "members": ["serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
    },
    {
      "role": "roles/logging.logWriter",
      "members": ["serviceAccount:image-signer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com"]
    }
  ]
}
```

Maria Serrano: We also need the key's IAM to allow the signing principal on the specific key version only (no key admin perms).

Linda Park: SGTM re: narrow scope. For audit retention bump — security prefers 180d for crypto ops, but 90d is acceptable for this short window if we add an automatic rollback to 30d after canary completes. @Chris (SRE) can infra schedule that?

Chris (SRE): Yep I can do the schedule. I'll apply the KMS binding to staging key first, and flip a feature flag to enable signing in image pipeline. Plan: apply RBAC at 21:30 UTC, run 1h canary signing of 10 images, gather attest logs, then promote. I'll tag the rollout in deploy tracking.

Nikhil Patel: Quick vuln-triage note — when you run the signed images through the SBOM scanner, please tag any diff in glibc/libssl layers. We had a regression last rebuild where glibc patching changed symlink ordering and caused a minor CVE alert. Keep the canary to 10 replicas.

Ben Liu: One more ask — can we include an ephemeral access approver step for the signer SA so that in case of compromise we revoke quickly? Maybe a time-limited binding (48h) and a follow-up cron to remove if not extended.

Maria Serrano: Good call. Chris, can you create the binding with TTL and add the cron job to revoke after 48h unless manually extended? Put notes in the runbook.

Chris (SRE): Yep. I'll create a short runbook snippet and post here. Also adding alerts for excessive signing volume > 20/min.

security-bot: Audit-change-request: retention: 90d -> pending approval from Security Leads. Link: https://redwood.sec/approvals/REQ-5921

Linda Park: Approving the 90d for this window, conditional on the TTL binding and the revoke cron. Approving now. :white_check_mark:

Maria Serrano: Thanks. Ben can you sign off on the IAM snippet? If so I'll ask infra to apply at 21:30 UTC.

Ben Liu: Signed off. Keep the role minimal. :+1:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: image-rebuild-base v2026-03-21T21:30Z -> canary (10 nodes). Notified oncall.

Maria Serrano: Ok team — execute and please paste the audit log sample (one signed artifact entry) into this thread when done so we can save it with the incident log. If anything weird happens ping #eng-oncall and @Chris immediately.

Chris (SRE): Will do. I'll post logs after the first signed canary.

Maria Serrano: Thanks all — keeping this tight to avoid large blast radius. :seedling:
